Select molecule ChEMBL identifier as molecule_chembl_id, preferred name as molecule_name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds associated with the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id CHEMBL4257575. Left join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES, allowing nulls. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL identifier.
